rules.statement: The five FIFO instances have depths 2, 16, 2, 2 and 2 entries respectively, with software-reset inactive and both clock/reset pins tied to shared inputs.

rules.quote: The design has no clock-domain crossing or CDC synchronizer. There is no CDC path.
rules.statement: The design contains no clock-domain crossing or CDC synchronizer.

rules.quote: Read: accept the AHB address phase on i_clk_core → enqueue one read descriptor → issue ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR → accept one R beat (RLAST=1) → return HRDATA and HRESP in the AHB data phase. WLAST is high exactly on the final AXI W beat; read ARLEN is always zero and expected RLAST is one.
rules.statement: The bridge issues ARLEN=0 and ARBURST=INCR, accepts one R beat with RLAST=1, and returns HRDATA and HRESP in the AHB data phase.

rules.quote: No next AHB read is accepted while the current read is unresolved.
rules.condition: While the current AHB read is unresolved
rules.statement: The bridge must not accept the next AHB read while the current read is unresolved.

rules.quote: Write single / undefined INCR / non-bufferable fixed burst: capture the AHB beat → issue one AXI write (AWLEN=0, one W beat, WLAST=1) → wait for B response → return AHB completion/error.
rules.condition: Write single, undefined INCR, or non-bufferable fixed burst beat
rules.statement: Issue one AXI write with AWLEN=0, one W beat with WLAST=1, wait for the B response, then return AHB completion/error.

rules.quote: Fixed non-bufferable bursts are serialized beat by beat.
rules.statement: Fixed non-bufferable bursts are serialized beat by beat.

rules.quote: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed write burst: collect all 4/8/16 AHB address/data beats in order.
rules.condition: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed write burst
rules.statement: Collect all 4/8/16 AHB address/data beats in order.

rules.quote: If all AXI address attributes are constant, emit one matching INCR/WRAP AXI burst; otherwise emit ordered AXI single-beat writes.
rules.statement: If all AXI address attributes are constant, emit one matching INCR/WRAP AXI burst; otherwise emit ordered AXI single-beat writes.

rules.quote: Keep Device-E and non-bufferable writes as singles.
rules.statement: Keep Device-E and non-bufferable writes as single AXI writes.

rules.quote: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats may complete OKAY; the terminal AHB beat waits for the required B response(s).
rules.condition: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats
rules.statement: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats may complete OKAY.

rules.quote: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats may complete OKAY; the terminal AHB beat waits for the required B response(s).
rules.condition: Terminal AHB beat of buffered write burst
rules.statement: The terminal AHB beat waits for the required B response(s).

rules.quote: Write burst fixed bufferable: gom đủ 4/8/16 beat theo thứ tự → phát một AXI burst INCR hoặc WRAP tương ứng → phát W và chỉ bật WLAST ở beat cuối → chờ BRESP → áp dụng response lên beat AHB cuối.
rules.statement: Assert WLAST only on the last W beat, wait for BRESP, and apply the response to the final AHB beat.

rules.quote: Both AHB and AXI interface signals are sampled or driven relative to the rising edge of the one physical clock i_clk_core.
rules.statement: AHB and AXI interface signals are sampled or driven relative to the rising edge of i_clk_core.

rules.quote: No AXI read address is issued before its corresponding AHB read address is accepted.
rules.statement: No AXI read address is issued before the corresponding AHB read address is accepted.

rules.quote: AHB and AXI transaction order is preserved; there is no read speculation or response reordering.
rules.statement: AHB and AXI transaction order is preserved, with no read speculation or response reordering.

rules.quote: AXI VALID and payload remain stable until READY handshake.
rules.condition: AXI VALID asserted and READY not yet high
rules.statement: AXI VALID and payload remain stable until the READY handshake.

rules.quote: An AXI burst is issued only when the complete AHB fixed write burst has been captured.
rules.condition: AHB fixed write burst not completely captured
rules.statement: An AXI burst is issued only when the complete AHB fixed write burst has been captured.

rules.quote: At most one read and one write transaction are outstanding; the chosen control policy does not allow a later AHB transaction to pass a stalled response.
rules.statement: At most one read and one write transaction are outstanding; a later AHB transaction must not pass a stalled response.

rules.quote: WLAST is high exactly on the final AXI W beat; read ARLEN is always zero and expected RLAST is one.
rules.statement: WLAST is high exactly on the final AXI W beat; read ARLEN is always zero and expected RLAST is one.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: A transfer is accepted at a rising i_clk_core edge when HSEL, HREADY and HTRANS[1] are all 1.
rules.condition: at a rising i_clk_core edge when HSEL, HREADY and HTRANS[1] are all 1
rules.statement: The bridge accepts a transfer at a rising i_clk_core edge when HSEL, HREADY and HTRANS[1] are all 1.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Address/control are taken from the address phase; HWDATA/HWSTRB belong to the corresponding data phase.
rules.statement: Address/control are taken from the address phase; HWDATA/HWSTRB belong to the corresponding data phase.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: BUSY and IDLE do not create AXI traffic. / Nhận transfer tại cạnh lên i_clk_core khi HSEL, HREADY, HTRANS[1] đều bằng 1. Địa chỉ/điều khiển thuộc address phase; HWDATA/HWSTRB thuộc data phase tương ứng. BUSY và IDLE không tạo AXI traffic.
rules.statement: BUSY and IDLE transfers must not create AXI traffic.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Supported HSIZE encodings are byte, halfword and word (0, 1, 2). Transfer addresses shall be naturally aligned to HSIZE.
rules.statement: Supported HSIZE encodings are byte, halfword and word (0,1,2), and transfer addresses shall be naturally aligned to HSIZE.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: HSIZE > 2, misaligned accesses, reserved HBURST values and unsupported/reserved HPROT memory-type encodings return AHB ERROR with no AXI request for the rejected transfer; any earlier accepted write prefix is drained under REQ-FUNC-009. / Hỗ trợ HSIZE byte, halfword, word (0, 1, 2); địa chỉ phải căn chỉnh tự nhiên. HSIZE > 2, địa chỉ lệch, HBURST/HPROT dành riêng hoặc không hỗ trợ trả AHB ERROR, không phát AXI cho transfer bị từ chối; prefix write đã nhận được xả theo REQ-FUNC-009.
rules.condition: HSIZE>2, misaligned access, reserved HBURST, or unsupported/reserved HPROT memory type
rules.statement: The bridge returns AHB ERROR with no AXI request for the rejected transfer; any earlier accepted write prefix is drained.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: AHB SINGLE and undefined INCR are converted to AXI single-beat INCR transactions.
rules.statement: AHB SINGLE and undefined INCR are converted to AXI single-beat INCR transactions.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Fixed INCR4/8/16 and WRAP4/8/16 reads still issue single-beat AR requests. / SINGLE và INCR không xác định được đổi thành AXI INCR một beat. Read INCR4/8/16 và WRAP4/8/16 vẫn phát AR một beat cho mỗi transfer.
rules.statement: Each read beat of fixed INCR/WRAP bursts issues its own single-beat AR request.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Aggregation is limited to complete legal Normal Write-back fixed write bursts with constant AXI address attributes.
rules.statement: AXI write burst aggregation is limited to complete legal Normal Write-back fixed write bursts with constant AXI address attributes.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Device writes are never merged. Không bao giờ gộp write Device.
rules.statement: Device writes must never be merged into an AXI burst.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: If an AHB fixed burst terminates early, drain captured but unissued beats as ordered AXI singles without reissuing beats already sent; never send a short AXI burst in place of the AHB burst. / Chỉ ghép burst write Normal Write-back fixed hợp lệ, đầy đủ, có thuộc tính AXI cấp địa chỉ không đổi. Nếu burst AHB kết thúc sớm, phát các beat đã nhận thành AXI single theo thứ tự; không phát AXI burst thiếu beat. Fixed-length AHB bursts may end early after an error or interconnect termination; any captured but unissued accepted write prefix is drained as AXI singles without reissuing beats already sent; no incomplete AXI burst is issued (REF-001 §3.6.2). / HPROT giữ nguyên trong burst AHB. Burst AHB độ dài cố định có thể kết thúc sớm do lỗi hoặc interconnect; các beat write đã nhận được xả thành AXI single, không phát AXI burst thiếu beat.
rules.statement: Captured but unissued write beats are drained as ordered AXI singles without reissuing sent beats; no short AXI burst replaces the AHB burst.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: AHB managers must not start an incrementing burst that crosses a 1 KiB boundary (REF-001 §3.6).
rules.statement: AHB managers must not start an incrementing burst that crosses a 1 KiB boundary.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: The bridge additionally keeps every AXI burst within a 4 KiB boundary (REF-002 §A3.4). The approved 4 KiB split is defensive behavior for an out-of-profile address sequence; it does not make an AHB 1 KiB-crossing burst protocol-compliant. / AHB manager không được bắt đầu INCR vượt biên 1 KiB.
rules.statement: The bridge keeps every AXI burst within a 4 KiB boundary, splitting defensively for out-of-profile address sequences.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: HPROT remains constant throughout an AHB burst (REF-001 §3.8).
rules.statement: HPROT remains constant throughout an AHB burst.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: If a burst-scoped AXI address attribute differs between accepted beats, the bridge uses ordered AXI singles. Nếu thuộc tính địa chỉ AXI cấp burst khác nhau giữa các beat đã nhận, bridge dùng AXI single theo thứ tự.
rules.condition: burst-scoped AXI address attribute differs between accepted beats
rules.statement: The bridge uses ordered AXI singles instead of a burst.

rules.section_title: AHB5 acceptance and supported profile / Nhận giao dịch AHB5 và profile hỗ trợ
rules.quote: The bridge issues no exclusive requests. HMASTLOCK=1 is rejected with AHB ERROR; HEXCL, HMASTER and HEXOKAY are not ports. / Bridge không phát exclusive.
rules.statement: The bridge issues no exclusive requests; HMASTLOCK=1 is rejected with AHB ERROR.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: AXI4 VALID and payload shall remain stable until READY handshakes. AXI outputs have no combinational dependency on AXI READY. / VALID và payload giữ ổn định đến khi bắt tay READY.
rules.condition: VALID asserted and READY not yet handshaken
rules.statement: AXI4 VALID and payload remain stable until READY handshakes; AXI outputs have no combinational dependency on READY.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: At most one read and one write transaction may be outstanding.
rules.statement: At most one read and one write transaction may be outstanding.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: Reads are single-beat (ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR, RLAST=1). Read luôn một beat (ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR, RLAST=1).
rules.statement: Reads are single-beat: ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR, RLAST=1.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: Writes are single-beat or fixed bursts up to 16 beats. / Tối đa một read và một write outstanding. Write một beat hoặc burst fixed tối đa 16 beat.
rules.statement: Writes are single-beat or fixed bursts up to 16 beats.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: AXI ID width is 3 bits. Each direction uses its configured count and rotates through IDs 0..count-1 after each completed AXI transaction. Mỗi hướng xoay ID 0..count-1 sau khi hoàn tất.
rules.statement: AXI ID is 3 bits; each direction rotates through IDs 0..count-1 after each completed transaction.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: Count >1 does not enable concurrent transactions. / ID rộng 3 bit. Count >1 không cho phép giao dịch đồng thời.
rules.statement: ID count greater than 1 does not enable concurrent transactions.

rules.section_title: AXI4 channel contract / Hợp đồng các kênh AXI4
rules.quote: If R or B response is not returned, the related AHB operation remains pending indefinitely. / IP không giới hạn latency response AXI. Nếu chưa có R/B, giao dịch AHB tương ứng tiếp tục chờ.
rules.condition: R or B response not returned
rules.statement: The related AHB operation remains pending indefinitely.

rules.quote: HPROT[6]=1 (Shareable) and reserved/unsupported memory-type combinations are rejected for that transfer before issuing its AXI request. / Đây là mapping riêng của bridge đã được duyệt, không phải ánh xạ 1:1 do Arm quy định. HPROT[6]=1 (Shareable) và tổ hợp memory type dành riêng/không hỗ trợ bị từ chối trước khi phát AXI. AHB input: HPROT[6]; AXI output: Not applicable: rejected with no AXI field mapping; Mapping / Ánh xạ: If 1, return AHB ERROR; no AXI request / Nếu 1, trả AHB ERROR, không phát AXI HPROT[6]=1 is rejected by the selected product policy; every unlisted pattern is reserved and returns AHB ERROR. / Các pattern HPROT[6:2] được hỗ trợ trong profile này nằm dưới đây. Chính sách sản phẩm từ chối HPROT[6]=1; pattern không liệt kê là reserved và trả AHB ERROR.
rules.statement: The transfer is rejected with AHB ERROR before any AXI request is issued.

rules.quote: AHB input: HPROT[1]; AXI output: AxPROT[0]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Pass-through privileged attribute / Truyền thuộc tính privileged AHB input: HNONSEC; AXI output: AxPROT[1]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Pass-through; 1 means Non-secure / Truyền trực tiếp; 1 là Non-secure AHB input: HPROT[0]; AXI output: AxPROT[2]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Invert; AxPROT[2]=~HPROT[0] / Đảo bit
rules.statement: AxPROT[0]=HPROT[1], AxPROT[1]=HNONSEC, AxPROT[2]=~HPROT[0].

rules.quote: AHB input: HPROT[3]; AXI output: AxCACHE[1]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Modifiable / Modifiable AHB input: HPROT[2]; AXI output: AxCACHE[0]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Bufferable / Bufferable AHB input: HPROT[4]=0; AXI output: AxCACHE[3:2]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: 00 (no lookup allocation) / 00 AHB input: HPROT[4]=1, HPROT[5]=1; AXI output: Read AxCACHE[2]; write AxCACHE[3]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Direction-specific Allocate / Allocate theo hướng AHB input: HPROT[4]=1, HPROT[5]=0; AXI output: Read AxCACHE[3]; write AxCACHE[2]; Mapping / Ánh xạ: Direction-specific Other-Allocate / Other-Allocate theo hướng
rules.statement: AxCACHE[1]=HPROT[3], AxCACHE[0]=HPROT[2]; HPROT[4]=0 gives AxCACHE[3:2]=00; HPROT[4]=1 sets direction-specific allocate bits per HPROT[5].

rules.quote: HPROT[6:2]: 0b0_0000; AHB5 memory type: Device-nE; Bridge behavior / Hành vi bridge: One AXI single per transfer; wait for final-destination BRESP / Mỗi transfer một AXI single; chờ BRESP đích cuối HPROT[6:2]: 0b0_0001; AHB5 memory type: Device-E; Bridge behavior / Hành vi bridge: Never merge; one AXI single per beat; wait for final-destination BRESP / Không gộp; mỗi beat một AXI single; chờ BRESP đích cuối Case: Device-E or non-bufferable fixed write; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: One AXI single per AHB beat; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: AXI burst merging; IP response / Phản hồi: Wait for each BRESP; Device-E response comes from final destination; Requirement: REQ-FUNC-005/008
rules.statement: Issue one AXI single per beat, never merge, and wait for final-destination BRESP.

rules.quote: HPROT[6:2]: 0b0_0010; AHB5 memory type: Normal Non-cacheable, Non-shareable; Bridge behavior / Hành vi bridge: Single-beat writes; no burst aggregation / Write một beat; không ghép burst HPROT[6:2]: 0b0_x110; AHB5 memory type: Write-through, Non-shareable; Bridge behavior / Hành vi bridge: Single-beat writes; no burst aggregation / Write một beat; không ghép burst
rules.statement: Writes are single-beat with no burst aggregation.

rules.quote: HPROT[6:2]: 0b0_x111; AHB5 memory type: Write-back, Non-shareable; Bridge behavior / Hành vi bridge: Eligible bufferable fixed bursts may aggregate if AXI address attributes are constant / Burst fixed bufferable đủ điều kiện có thể ghép nếu thuộc tính địa chỉ AXI không đổi
rules.condition: Write-back eligible bufferable fixed burst with constant AXI address attributes
rules.statement: The bridge may aggregate such bursts into an AXI burst.

rules.section_title: Protocol cases / Các trường hợp giao thức
rules.quote: Case: AHB read; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: Single accepted address; return one AXI R beat; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: Speculative or multi-beat AXI read; IP response / Phản hồi: AHB waits for R; map RRESP; Requirement: REQ-FUNC-003
rules.statement: One accepted address returns one AXI R beat; no speculative or multi-beat read; AHB waits for R and maps RRESP.

rules.section_title: Protocol cases / Các trường hợp giao thức
rules.quote: Case: AHB single/INCR write; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: One AHB beat to one AXI single; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: Undefined-length AXI aggregation; IP response / Phản hồi: Wait for BRESP; Requirement: REQ-FUNC-004
rules.statement: One AHB beat maps to one AXI single with no undefined-length aggregation; wait for BRESP.

rules.section_title: Protocol cases / Các trường hợp giao thức
rules.quote: Case: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed write; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: Full 4/8/16-beat burst; one AXI burst only if address attributes are uniform; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: Device-E, varying address attributes or incomplete burst; IP response / Phản hồi: Bufferable early OKAY for prior beats; terminal HRESP reflects final B status; Requirement: REQ-FUNC-005/007/008/009
rules.statement: A full 4/8/16-beat burst uses one AXI burst only with uniform attributes; prior beats get early OKAY and terminal HRESP reflects final B status.

rules.section_title: Protocol cases / Các trường hợp giao thức
rules.quote: Case: HMASTLOCK or HPROT shareable; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: No AXI request for the rejected transfer; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: Locked/shareable traffic; IP response / Phản hồi: Two-cycle AHB ERROR; drain any previously accepted write prefix; Requirement: REQ-ERR-002/009
rules.statement: No AXI request for the rejected transfer; two-cycle AHB ERROR; drain any previously accepted write prefix.

rules.section_title: Protocol cases / Các trường hợp giao thức
rules.quote: Case: AXI R/B status; Legal behavior / Hành vi hợp lệ: Accept valid response; Unsupported / Không hỗ trợ: EXOKAY is unexpected without exclusives; IP response / Phản hồi: Non-OKAY maps to AHB ERROR; Requirement: REQ-ERR-001
rules.statement: Non-OKAY maps to AHB ERROR.

rules.quote: Assumption: no interrupt or event output is included; supported errors are returned on the AHB response channel.
rules.statement: The bridge IP includes no interrupt or event output port.

rules.quote: Assumption: no interrupt or event output is included; supported errors are returned on the AHB response channel.
rules.statement: Supported errors are returned to the AHB master on the AHB response channel (HRESP) rather than via an interrupt or event output.

rules.quote: Domain: CLK-CORE; Physical port: i_clk_core; Edge: Rising; Frequency target: TBD by SoC integration; Relationship: Shared by AHB, AXI and all FIFO instances; Gating: No internal clock gating At this IP boundary both use the same physical i_clk_core input.
rules.statement: AHB HCLK and AXI ACLK, and all FIFO instances, must use the same physical i_clk_core input, rising-edge, with no internal clock gating.

rules.quote: There is one clock domain, CLK-CORE. The bridge contains no asynchronous crossing, synchronizer chain, Gray pointer or CDC FIFO.
rules.statement: The bridge must operate in the single CLK-CORE domain and must not contain asynchronous crossings, synchronizer chains, Gray pointers or CDC FIFOs.

rules.quote: Each m_vlsit_sfifo_top write/read clock input is tied to i_clk_core; its two reset inputs are tied to i_rst_n_core.
rules.statement: Each m_vlsit_sfifo_top write/read clock input must be tied to i_clk_core and its two reset inputs tied to i_rst_n_core.

rules.quote: Reset ID: RST-CORE; Port: i_rst_n_core; Polarity / assertion: Active-low, asynchronous assertion; Scope: All bridge logic and all five FIFOs; Deassertion: SoC source synchronizes deassertion to i_clk_core before the IP boundary; no internal synchronizer; Reset values: HREADYOUT=1; HRESP=OKAY; AW/W/ARVALID=0; BREADY/RREADY=0; FIFO valid state cleared
rules.statement: Reset values must be HREADYOUT=1, HRESP=OKAY, AWVALID/WVALID/ARVALID=0, BREADY/RREADY=0, and FIFO valid state cleared, for all bridge logic and five FIFOs.

rules.quote: Reset ID: RST-CORE; Port: i_rst_n_core; Polarity / assertion: Active-low, asynchronous assertion; Scope: All bridge logic and all five FIFOs; Deassertion: SoC source synchronizes deassertion to i_clk_core before the IP boundary; no internal synchronizer; Reset values: HREADYOUT=1; HRESP=OKAY; AW/W/ARVALID=0; BREADY/RREADY=0; FIFO valid state cleared The system provides one reset net to both protocol sides and all FIFOs. The SoC reset source asserts it asynchronously and synchronizes deassertion to i_clk_core before it reaches the IP.
rules.statement: The SoC must provide one active-low reset net i_rst_n_core to both protocol sides and all FIFOs, asserted asynchronously and with deassertion synchronized to i_clk_core before the IP.

rules.quote: The RTL uses i_rst_n_core directly and contains no reset synchronizer.
rules.statement: The RTL must use i_rst_n_core directly and must not contain a reset synchronizer.

rules.quote: No transaction is accepted until reset release.
rules.statement: No transaction may be accepted by the bridge until reset is released.

rules.quote: Reset discards bridge-buffered commands/data and responses in flight; the system shall reset the connected AXI endpoint/interconnect consistently so a stale response cannot be mistaken for a new transaction. / Hệ thống cấp một net reset cho cả hai giao thức và toàn bộ FIFO.
rules.condition: When reset discards bridge-buffered commands/data and in-flight responses
rules.statement: The system must reset the connected AXI endpoint/interconnect consistently so a stale response cannot be mistaken for a new transaction.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_RD_ID_COUNT; Purpose / Mục đích: Number of read IDs in rotation / Số ID read xoay vòng; Default: 1; Legal range: 1..8; Dependency and impact: ID width remains 3; count does not increase outstanding capacity
rules.statement: PARA_RD_ID_COUNT, the number of read IDs in rotation, must default to 1 and be within the legal range 1..8.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_RD_ID_COUNT; Purpose / Mục đích: Number of read IDs in rotation / Số ID read xoay vòng; Default: 1; Legal range: 1..8; Dependency and impact: ID width remains 3; count does not increase outstanding capacity
rules.statement: The read ID width must remain 3 regardless of PARA_RD_ID_COUNT, and the count must not increase outstanding capacity.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_WR_ID_COUNT; Purpose / Mục đích: Number of write IDs in rotation / Số ID write xoay vòng; Default: 1; Legal range: 1..8; Dependency and impact: ID width remains 3; count does not increase outstanding capacity
rules.statement: PARA_WR_ID_COUNT, the number of write IDs in rotation, must default to 1 and be within the legal range 1..8.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_WR_ID_COUNT; Purpose / Mục đích: Number of write IDs in rotation / Số ID write xoay vòng; Default: 1; Legal range: 1..8; Dependency and impact: ID width remains 3; count does not increase outstanding capacity
rules.statement: The write ID width must remain 3 regardless of PARA_WR_ID_COUNT, and the count must not increase outstanding capacity.

rules.quote: No USER sideband or USER-width parameters are defined.
rules.statement: No USER sideband or USER-width parameters are defined.

rules.quote: AXI address/data/ID widths, FIFO depths and protocol features are not user-overridable in this revision.
rules.statement: AXI address, data and ID widths, FIFO depths and protocol features must not be user-overridable in this revision.

rules.quote: VLSIT parameter comment contract / Quy ước comment parameter VLSIT: immediately above each RTL parameter, use // Parameter Description: ..., // Parameter values: ..., and // Parameter unit: ... in that order. / Ngay trên mỗi parameter RTL phải có ba comment theo đúng thứ tự: Description, values, unit.
rules.statement: Immediately above each RTL parameter, comments // Parameter Description, // Parameter values and // Parameter unit must appear in that order.

rules.quote: Item: Address; Definition / Định nghĩa: 32-bit byte address; AXI address equals the corresponding accepted AHB address. / Địa chỉ byte 32 bit; địa chỉ AXI bằng địa chỉ AHB đã nhận.
rules.condition: When an AHB transfer is accepted and forwarded to AXI
rules.statement: The AXI address must equal the corresponding accepted AHB address (32-bit byte address).

rules.quote: Item: Data; Definition / Định nghĩa: AHB HWDATA and AXI WDATA are 32 bits; AHB HRDATA and AXI RDATA are 32 bits. The bridge does not byte-swap. / HWDATA/WDATA và HRDATA/RDATA rộng 32 bit; bridge không đổi thứ tự byte.
rules.statement: HWDATA, WDATA, HRDATA and RDATA must each be 32 bits wide.

rules.quote: Item: Data; Definition / Định nghĩa: AHB HWDATA and AXI WDATA are 32 bits; AHB HRDATA and AXI RDATA are 32 bits. The bridge does not byte-swap. / HWDATA/WDATA và HRDATA/RDATA rộng 32 bit; bridge không đổi thứ tự byte.
rules.statement: The bridge must not byte-swap data between AHB and AXI.

rules.quote: Item: Transfer size; Definition / Định nghĩa: HSIZE/AxSIZE 0=1 byte, 1=2 bytes, 2=4 bytes. Larger sizes are rejected. / HSIZE/AxSIZE 0=1 byte, 1=2 byte, 2=4 byte; kích thước lớn hơn bị từ chối.
rules.statement: HSIZE/AxSIZE must encode 0 as 1 byte, 1 as 2 bytes and 2 as 4 bytes.

rules.quote: Item: Transfer size; Definition / Định nghĩa: HSIZE/AxSIZE 0=1 byte, 1=2 bytes, 2=4 bytes. Larger sizes are rejected. / HSIZE/AxSIZE 0=1 byte, 1=2 byte, 2=4 byte; kích thước lớn hơn bị từ chối.
rules.condition: When HSIZE indicates a size larger than 4 bytes
rules.statement: The bridge must reject transfers with sizes larger than 4 bytes.

rules.quote: Item: Byte lanes; Definition / Định nghĩa: HWSTRB[n] and WSTRB[n] qualify HWDATA/WDATA byte [8n+7:8n]; strobe is passed per beat. / HWSTRB[n] và WSTRB[n] điều kiện hóa byte [8n+7:8n]; truyền strobe từng beat.
rules.statement: HWSTRB[n] and WSTRB[n] must qualify byte [8n+7:8n] of HWDATA/WDATA respectively.

rules.quote: Item: Byte lanes; Definition / Định nghĩa: HWSTRB[n] and WSTRB[n] qualify HWDATA/WDATA byte [8n+7:8n]; strobe is passed per beat. / HWSTRB[n] và WSTRB[n] điều kiện hóa byte [8n+7:8n]; truyền strobe từng beat.
rules.statement: The strobe must be passed from HWSTRB to WSTRB per beat.

rules.quote: Item: Endianness; Definition / Định nghĩa: No endian conversion. Endianness interpretation belongs to the connected system. / Không đổi endian; hệ thống kết nối quyết định diễn giải endian.
rules.statement: The bridge must not perform any endian conversion.

rules.quote: Item: Burst length; Definition / Định nghĩa: AXI LEN is beat count minus one. Single-beat LEN=0; aggregated write burst LEN is 3, 7 or 15 before boundary split. / AXI LEN bằng số beat trừ một. LEN một beat=0; burst ghép LEN=3, 7, 15 trước khi split biên.
rules.statement: AXI LEN must equal the beat count minus one.

rules.quote: Item: Burst length; Definition / Định nghĩa: AXI LEN is beat count minus one. Single-beat LEN=0; aggregated write burst LEN is 3, 7 or 15 before boundary split. / AXI LEN bằng số beat trừ một. LEN một beat=0; burst ghép LEN=3, 7, 15 trước khi split biên.
rules.statement: LEN must be 0 for a single-beat transfer.

rules.quote: Item: Burst length; Definition / Định nghĩa: AXI LEN is beat count minus one. Single-beat LEN=0; aggregated write burst LEN is 3, 7 or 15 before boundary split. / AXI LEN bằng số beat trừ một. LEN một beat=0; burst ghép LEN=3, 7, 15 trước khi split biên.
rules.condition: Aggregated write burst, before boundary split
rules.statement: AWLEN must be 3, 7 or 15 for an aggregated write burst before boundary split.

rules.quote: Item: ID; Definition / Định nghĩa: Unsigned 3-bit value; each direction rotates independently through the configured count. / Giá trị không dấu 3 bit; mỗi hướng xoay ID độc lập theo count.
rules.statement: ID must be an unsigned 3-bit value.

rules.quote: Item: ID; Definition / Định nghĩa: Unsigned 3-bit value; each direction rotates independently through the configured count. / Giá trị không dấu 3 bit; mỗi hướng xoay ID độc lập theo count.
rules.statement: Each direction (read and write) must rotate its ID independently through the configured count.

rules.quote: An eligible fixed Normal Write-back write may remain in capture until all expected beats are received; a terminated burst drains its captured prefix as AXI singles.
rules.statement: An eligible fixed Normal Write-back write may remain in capture until all expected beats are received.

rules.quote: An eligible fixed Normal Write-back write may remain in capture until all expected beats are received; a terminated burst drains its captured prefix as AXI singles. Operation ID: OP-WR-FALLBACK; Trigger: Normal Write-back fixed burst with varying AXI address attributes, or captured unissued prefix of an early-terminated fixed write; AXI action: Ordered AXI singles for remaining captured beats; do not reissue completed beats; AHB completion: Aggregate relevant B errors to the terminal AHB beat
rules.statement: A terminated fixed write burst must drain its captured prefix as AXI singles.

rules.quote: Illegal AHB controls enter the two-cycle AHB ERROR response without AXI issue. Operation ID: OP-ERR-LOCAL; Trigger: Unsupported lock/attribute/size/alignment/encoding; AXI action: No AXI request; AHB completion: Two-cycle AHB ERROR
rules.statement: The bridge must return a two-cycle AHB ERROR response and issue no AXI request for the rejected transfer.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-READ-SINGLE; Trigger: Accepted read, any HBURST; AXI action: One AR, ARLEN=0; one R beat; AHB completion: HRDATA with HRESP derived from RRESP
rules.statement: The bridge must issue one AR with ARLEN=0, receive one R beat, and complete AHB with HRDATA and HRESP derived from RRESP.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-WR-SINGLE; Trigger: SINGLE, undefined INCR beat, Device-E beat, or non-bufferable fixed-burst beat; AXI action: One AWLEN=0, one W beat, WLAST=1; AHB completion: Wait for BRESP; map the response to that AHB transfer
rules.condition: SINGLE, undefined INCR beat, Device-E beat, or non-bufferable fixed-burst beat
rules.statement: The bridge must issue one AW with AWLEN=0 and one W beat with WLAST=1, wait for BRESP, and map the response to that AHB transfer.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-WR-BURST; Trigger: Complete eligible bufferable Normal Write-back INCR4/8/16 or WRAP4/8/16 burst with uniform address attributes; AXI action: One AW/W burst up to 16 beats; 4 KiB split if needed; AHB completion: Earlier accepted beats may return OKAY; terminal beat waits for all corresponding BRESPs
rules.condition: Complete eligible bufferable Normal Write-back INCR4/8/16 or WRAP4/8/16 burst with uniform address attributes
rules.statement: The bridge must issue one AW/W burst of up to 16 beats, splitting at 4 KiB if needed; the terminal AHB beat waits for all corresponding BRESPs.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-WR-BURST; Trigger: Complete eligible bufferable Normal Write-back INCR4/8/16 or WRAP4/8/16 burst with uniform address attributes; AXI action: One AW/W burst up to 16 beats; 4 KiB split if needed; AHB completion: Earlier accepted beats may return OKAY; terminal beat waits for all corresponding BRESPs
rules.statement: Earlier accepted beats of an AXI write burst may return OKAY before the BRESPs arrive.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-WR-FALLBACK; Trigger: Normal Write-back fixed burst with varying AXI address attributes, or captured unissued prefix of an early-terminated fixed write; AXI action: Ordered AXI singles for remaining captured beats; do not reissue completed beats; AHB completion: Aggregate relevant B errors to the terminal AHB beat
rules.condition: Normal Write-back fixed burst with varying AXI address attributes, or captured unissued prefix of early-terminated fixed write
rules.statement: The bridge must issue ordered AXI singles for remaining captured beats, not reissue completed beats, and aggregate relevant B errors to the terminal AHB beat.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-RESET; Trigger: Assert the single shared reset i_rst_n_core; AXI action: Drop in-flight queues and VALID state; AHB completion: HREADYOUT=1 during reset; no stale response after the AXI endpoint/interconnect is reset consistently
rules.statement: On assertion of i_rst_n_core the bridge must drop in-flight queues and VALID state and drive HREADYOUT=1 during reset.

rules.quote: Operation ID: OP-RESET; Trigger: Assert the single shared reset i_rst_n_core; AXI action: Drop in-flight queues and VALID state; AHB completion: HREADYOUT=1 during reset; no stale response after the AXI endpoint/interconnect is reset consistently
rules.condition: After AXI endpoint/interconnect is reset consistently
rules.statement: No stale response may appear after reset once the AXI endpoint/interconnect is reset consistently.

rules.quote: Every waveform uses the shared rising-edge clock i_clk_core and the single reset i_rst_n_core; edge positions are illustrative, not an absolute timing guarantee. The AHB and AXI sides share one i_clk_core; there is no clock ratio or phase relationship to configure. / AHB và AXI dùng chung i_clk_core; không có tỷ lệ hay quan hệ pha clock cần cấu hình.
rules.statement: AHB and AXI sides must share the single rising-edge clock i_clk_core and single reset i_rst_n_core.

rules.quote: Read requests are serialized. AHB does not accept the next read until the current R data/status returns.
rules.condition: Current read's R data/status not yet returned
rules.statement: The bridge must serialize reads and must not accept the next AHB read until the current R data/status returns.

rules.quote: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed writes can accept one AHB beat per i_clk_core cycle while the 16-entry buffer has room.
rules.condition: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed writes while the 16-entry buffer has room
rules.statement: The bridge can accept one AHB beat per i_clk_core cycle.

rules.quote: Device-E and non-bufferable writes wait for each single-beat BRESP; Device-E is not acknowledged before the final destination responds. / Write Normal Write-back fixed đủ điều kiện có thể nhận một beat mỗi chu kỳ i_clk_core khi buffer 16 entry còn chỗ.
rules.statement: The bridge must wait for each single-beat BRESP and must not acknowledge Device-E before the final destination responds.

rules.quote: Single read and single-beat write AR/AW request handshake target: no more than 6 i_clk_core cycles from accepted AHB address, provided the synchronous queue has space and the corresponding AXI READY stays high.
rules.condition: Single read or single-beat write, synchronous queue has space and AXI READY stays high
rules.statement: The AR/AW handshake should complete within 6 i_clk_core cycles of the accepted AHB address.

rules.quote: For fixed-length write bursts, the target starts after full-burst or early-termination capture. / Mục tiêu bắt tay AR/AW giao dịch đơn: không quá 6 chu kỳ i_clk_core từ lúc nhận địa chỉ AHB nếu queue đồng bộ còn chỗ và READY luôn cao. For every fixed-length write burst, the AW latency bound begins after the complete AHB burst or its early termination has been captured; the first AHB address is not covered by the six-cycle target. This prevents issuing an AXI burst that cannot be completed if the AHB burst is interrupted. / Với write burst cố định, latency AW tính từ lúc đã nhận đủ burst AHB hoặc nhận biết kết thúc sớm; không cam kết sáu chu kỳ từ địa chỉ đầu.
rules.statement: The AW latency bound starts after the complete AHB burst or its early termination is captured, not from the first AHB address; no AXI burst is issued before capture.

rules.quote: Absolute latency in time units and throughput in MB/s remain TBD until the shared clock frequency is supplied. / Latency hoàn tất và thông lượng phụ thuộc AXI READY và response R/B.
rules.statement: Absolute latency and MB/s throughput remain TBD until the shared clock frequency is supplied.

rules.quote: Read/write arbitration follows AHB acceptance order. Since a transfer is held until its result when required, no later transaction bypasses an unresolved AHB operation. / Điều phối read/write theo thứ tự nhận AHB.
rules.statement: Read/write arbitration must follow AHB acceptance order, and no later transaction may bypass an unresolved AHB operation.

rules.quote: Write-data storage holds at least one complete 16-beat burst.
rules.statement: Write-data storage must hold at least one complete 16-beat burst.

rules.quote: Command and response stores hold one active transaction.
rules.statement: Command and response stores must hold one active transaction.

rules.quote: FIFO payload contents need not be reset; pointer and validity state are cleared by the shared reset.
rules.statement: FIFO pointer and validity state must be cleared by the shared reset; payload contents need not be reset.

rules.quote: Both clock pins and both hardware-reset pins of each FIFO connect to i_clk_core and i_rst_n_core, respectively. / Bridge dùng năm FIFO đồng bộ m_vlsit_sfifo_top như §5.1.
rules.statement: Both clock pins and both hardware-reset pins of each FIFO must connect to i_clk_core and i_rst_n_core respectively.

rules.quote: Not required (confirmed by user, 2026-10-25): the IP has no software-visible registers. There is no CSR workbook. / Không yêu cầu (người dùng xác nhận, 2026-10-25): IP không có thanh ghi phần mềm; parameter elaboration cấu hình xoay ID. Không cần workbook CSR.
rules.statement: The IP has no software-visible registers and no CSR workbook is required.

rules.quote: Static elaboration parameters configure ID rotation. The SoC integrator chooses static parameters at build/elaboration time. / Không áp dụng: không có chuỗi thao tác phần mềm; SoC integrator chọn parameter tĩnh khi build/elaboration.
rules.statement: ID rotation is configured through static elaboration parameters chosen by the SoC integrator, not by software sequences.

rules.quote: Error condition: HMASTLOCK=1; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: Transfer rejected; drain any accepted write prefix before terminal response
rules.statement: The bridge must reject a transfer with HMASTLOCK=1 using a two-cycle ERROR response and issue no AXI request for it.

rules.quote: Error condition: HMASTLOCK=1; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: Transfer rejected; drain any accepted write prefix before terminal response
rules.condition: HMASTLOCK=1 rejection with an accepted write prefix
rules.statement: The bridge must drain any accepted write prefix before giving the terminal ERROR response for a transfer rejected for HMASTLOCK=1.

rules.quote: Error condition: HPROT[6]=1 or unsupported/reserved HPROT; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: No AXI side effect for rejected beat; drain any accepted write prefix
rules.statement: The bridge must reject a transfer with HPROT[6]=1 or unsupported/reserved HPROT using a two-cycle ERROR response, with no AXI request or side effect for the rejected beat.

rules.quote: Error condition: HPROT[6]=1 or unsupported/reserved HPROT; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: No AXI side effect for rejected beat; drain any accepted write prefix
rules.condition: HPROT rejection with an accepted write prefix
rules.statement: The bridge must drain any accepted write prefix when rejecting a beat for HPROT error.

rules.quote: Error condition: HSIZE>2, misalignment, reserved HBURST; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: No AXI side effect for rejected beat; drain any accepted write prefix
rules.statement: The bridge must reject a transfer with HSIZE>2, misalignment or reserved HBURST using a two-cycle ERROR response, with no AXI request or side effect for the rejected beat.

rules.quote: Error condition: HSIZE>2, misalignment, reserved HBURST; AXI issued?: No request for the rejected transfer; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR; Recovery / Hành động: No AXI side effect for rejected beat; drain any accepted write prefix
rules.condition: HSIZE/alignment/HBURST rejection with an accepted write prefix
rules.statement: The bridge must drain any accepted write prefix when rejecting a beat for HSIZE, misalignment or reserved HBURST.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI RRESP=SLVERR/DECERR/EXOKAY; AXI issued?: Yes; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR response for read; Recovery / Hành động: Consume R beat; report mapped error
rules.condition: AXI RRESP is SLVERR, DECERR or EXOKAY
rules.statement: The bridge must consume the R beat and return a two-cycle AHB ERROR response for the read, reporting the mapped error.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI BRESP=SLVERR/DECERR/EXOKAY; AXI issued?: Yes; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR for a single write, or terminal AHB beat of a Normal Write-back burst handled as an AXI burst/singles; Recovery / Hành động: Earlier buffered beats remain acknowledged; terminal status reflects all B responses
rules.condition: AXI BRESP is SLVERR, DECERR or EXOKAY
rules.statement: The bridge must return a two-cycle ERROR for a single write, or on the terminal AHB beat of a Normal Write-back burst, when BRESP is SLVERR/DECERR/EXOKAY.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI BRESP=SLVERR/DECERR/EXOKAY; AXI issued?: Yes; AHB behavior: Two-cycle ERROR for a single write, or terminal AHB beat of a Normal Write-back burst handled as an AXI burst/singles; Recovery / Hành động: Earlier buffered beats remain acknowledged; terminal status reflects all B responses
rules.condition: Normal Write-back burst with a B error
rules.statement: Earlier buffered beats must remain acknowledged, and the terminal status must reflect all B responses.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI READY low; AXI issued?: Request may be pending; AHB behavior: AHB waits subject to buffering contract; Recovery / Hành động: Hold VALID/payload stable until handshake
rules.condition: AXI READY is low while a request is pending
rules.statement: The bridge must hold VALID and payload stable until the AXI handshake completes.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI R/B response never arrives; AXI issued?: Yes; AHB behavior: AHB waits indefinitely; Recovery / Hành động: No internal timeout; system-level watchdog/reset owns recovery
rules.statement: The bridge must not implement an internal timeout; AHB waits indefinitely and recovery is left to a system-level watchdog/reset.

rules.quote: Error condition: Fixed write burst terminates early; AXI issued?: Only captured, unissued prefix beats use AXI singles; AHB behavior: Terminal AHB response waits for all relevant B responses; errors are aggregated and completed beats are not reissued; Recovery / Hành động: Drain prefix in order; do not send an incomplete AXI burst
rules.statement: Only captured, unissued prefix beats use AXI singles, drained in order; the bridge must not send an incomplete AXI burst.

rules.quote: Error condition: Fixed write burst terminates early; AXI issued?: Only captured, unissued prefix beats use AXI singles; AHB behavior: Terminal AHB response waits for all relevant B responses; errors are aggregated and completed beats are not reissued; Recovery / Hành động: Drain prefix in order; do not send an incomplete AXI burst
rules.statement: The terminal AHB response must wait for all relevant B responses, aggregate errors, and not reissue completed beats.

rules.quote: Error condition: Coordinated reset during transaction; AXI issued?: In-flight state is discarded; AHB behavior: Reset contract applies; Recovery / Hành động: Reset the bridge and connected endpoint/interconnect consistently
rules.statement: In-flight state is discarded and the bridge and connected endpoint/interconnect are reset consistently.

rules.quote: Error condition: AXI response ID/RLAST violates AXI4; AXI issued?: Undefined by this IP profile; AHB behavior: External AXI protocol checker must report violation; Recovery / Hành động: Endpoint violates REF-002; bridge does not promise recovery
rules.statement: An external AXI protocol checker must report the violation; the endpoint is in violation and the bridge does not promise recovery.

rules.quote: AHB ERROR timing follows REF-001 §5.1: the first ERROR cycle has HREADYOUT low and the second has HREADYOUT high.
rules.statement: In the first ERROR cycle HREADYOUT must be low and in the second ERROR cycle HREADYOUT must be high.

rules.quote: AXI errors are not returned as AHB split responses. / Timing AHB ERROR theo REF-001 §5.1: chu kỳ lỗi đầu HREADYOUT thấp, chu kỳ thứ hai HREADYOUT cao. Lỗi AXI không được chuyển thành split response AHB.
rules.statement: AXI errors must not be returned as AHB split responses.

rules.quote: Metric: Single request issue; Target / contract: ≤6 i_clk_core cycles under §10.4 conditions; Evidence status: Cycle-based design target; requires implementation verification
rules.condition: Under the §10.4 conditions, for a single request
rules.statement: A single request should be issued within at most 6 i_clk_core cycles; this is a cycle-based design target requiring implementation verification.

rules.quote: RTL shall follow VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: synthesizable SystemVerilog, logic signal declarations, no package, no plain always, no always_latch, no define/ undef, no signed types, always_comb and always_ff with process prefixes p_com_ and p_ff_, active-low reset names use prefix i_rst_n_ followed by the clock-domain name, and documented logic sections. RTL phải theo VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: SystemVerilog tổng hợp được, khai báo tín hiệu kiểu logic, không dùng package, always thường, always_latch, define/ undef hoặc kiểu signed; dùng always_comb/always_ff với prefix process p_com_/p_ff_; reset active-low dùng prefix i_rst_n_ kèm tên miền clock; comment mô tả từng khối logic.
rules.statement: RTL shall be synthesizable SystemVerilog following VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 using logic declarations, with no package, plain always, always_latch, define/undef, or signed types.

rules.quote: RTL shall follow VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: synthesizable SystemVerilog, logic signal declarations, no package, no plain always, no always_latch, no define/ undef, no signed types, always_comb and always_ff with process prefixes p_com_ and p_ff_, active-low reset names use prefix i_rst_n_ followed by the clock-domain name, and documented logic sections. RTL phải theo VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: SystemVerilog tổng hợp được, khai báo tín hiệu kiểu logic, không dùng package, always thường, always_latch, define/ undef hoặc kiểu signed; dùng always_comb/always_ff với prefix process p_com_/p_ff_; reset active-low dùng prefix i_rst_n_ kèm tên miền clock; comment mô tả từng khối logic.
rules.statement: RTL shall use always_comb and always_ff with process prefixes p_com_ and p_ff_ respectively, and document each logic section with comments.

rules.quote: RTL shall follow VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: synthesizable SystemVerilog, logic signal declarations, no package, no plain always, no always_latch, no define/ undef, no signed types, always_comb and always_ff with process prefixes p_com_ and p_ff_, active-low reset names use prefix i_rst_n_ followed by the clock-domain name, and documented logic sections. RTL phải theo VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2: SystemVerilog tổng hợp được, khai báo tín hiệu kiểu logic, không dùng package, always thường, always_latch, define/ undef hoặc kiểu signed; dùng always_comb/always_ff với prefix process p_com_/p_ff_; reset active-low dùng prefix i_rst_n_ kèm tên miền clock; comment mô tả từng khối logic.
rules.statement: Active-low reset names shall use prefix i_rst_n_ followed by the clock-domain name.

rules.quote: All parameters use uppercase PARA_ names; localparams use uppercase LPARA_; enum type names end in _type_def. Parameter viết hoa với PARA_; localparam LPARA_; tên enum kết thúc _type_def.
rules.statement: Parameters use uppercase PARA_ names, localparams use uppercase LPARA_ names, and enum type names end in _type_def.

rules.quote: Protocol signal names follow §6. Tên tín hiệu protocol theo §6.
rules.statement: Protocol signal names follow section 6.

rules.quote: Module: m_ahb2axi_top; File: m_ahb2axi_top.sv; Responsibility: Single structural top; fixed AHB/AXI ports; Instance policy: Instantiates only u_ahb2axi_ctrl The top contains only u_ahb2axi_ctrl; the controller contains its control RTL plus instances of the two interface modules and five reused FIFOs. Top chỉ chứa u_ahb2axi_ctrl; controller chứa RTL điều khiển cùng các instance của hai module giao diện và năm FIFO dùng lại.
rules.statement: m_ahb2axi_top is the single structural top with fixed AHB/AXI ports and instantiates only u_ahb2axi_ctrl.

rules.quote: Module: m_ahb2axi_ahb_if; File: m_ahb2axi_ahb_if.sv; Responsibility: AHB protocol phases and AHB responses; Instance policy: One instance in m_ahb2axi_ctrl: u_ahb2axi_ahb_if Module: m_ahb2axi_ctrl; File: m_ahb2axi_ctrl.sv; Responsibility: The central control module between AHB and AXI interfaces; transfer control, burst handling, attribute mapping and ID rotation; Instance policy: Instantiates one AHB interface, one AXI interface and five FIFO instances u_vlsit_sfifo_top_0 through _4 Module: m_ahb2axi_axi_if; File: m_ahb2axi_axi_if.sv; Responsibility: AXI channel handshakes and response capture; Instance policy: One instance in m_ahb2axi_ctrl: u_ahb2axi_axi_if The top contains only u_ahb2axi_ctrl; the controller contains its control RTL plus instances of the two interface modules and five reused FIFOs. Top chỉ chứa u_ahb2axi_ctrl; controller chứa RTL điều khiển cùng các instance của hai module giao diện và năm FIFO dùng lại.
rules.statement: m_ahb2axi_ctrl instantiates one m_ahb2axi_ahb_if (u_ahb2axi_ahb_if) and one m_ahb2axi_axi_if (u_ahb2axi_axi_if) plus its control RTL.

rules.quote: Module: m_ahb2axi_ctrl; File: m_ahb2axi_ctrl.sv; Responsibility: The central control module between AHB and AXI interfaces; transfer control, burst handling, attribute mapping and ID rotation; Instance policy: Instantiates one AHB interface, one AXI interface and five FIFO instances u_vlsit_sfifo_top_0 through _4 Module: m_vlsit_sfifo_top; File: Existing common_rtl/002_SyncFIFO RTL; Responsibility: Synchronous command/data/response queues; Instance policy: Reused five times; both clock pins tie to i_clk_core, both hardware-reset pins tie to i_rst_n_core The top contains only u_ahb2axi_ctrl; the controller contains its control RTL plus instances of the two interface modules and five reused FIFOs. Repeated FIFO instance indexes start at zero. / Hierarchy RTL có một top m_ahb2axi_top và ba module chức năng: giao diện AHB, controller trung tâm và giao diện AXI. Top chỉ chứa u_ahb2axi_ctrl; controller chứa RTL điều khiển cùng các instance của hai module giao diện và năm FIFO dùng lại. Index FIFO bắt đầu từ 0.
rules.statement: m_ahb2axi_ctrl instantiates five m_vlsit_sfifo_top FIFOs named u_vlsit_sfifo_top_0 through _4, with indexes starting at zero.

rules.quote: Module: m_vlsit_sfifo_top; File: Existing common_rtl/002_SyncFIFO RTL; Responsibility: Synchronous command/data/response queues; Instance policy: Reused five times; both clock pins tie to i_clk_core, both hardware-reset pins tie to i_rst_n_core
rules.statement: Both clock pins of each FIFO instance tie to i_clk_core and both hardware-reset pins tie to i_rst_n_core.

rules.quote: Each module is stored in a file with the same basename. Mỗi module nằm trong file trùng tên.
rules.statement: Each module is stored in a file with the same basename as the module.

rules.quote: The synthesis flow shall use the sole top m_ahb2axi_top, legal parameter overrides, library, a single i_clk_core constraint, reset treatment and memory mapping. Flow dùng top duy nhất m_ahb2axi_top, parameter hợp lệ, thư viện và constraint duy nhất cho i_clk_core, xử lý reset và memory mapping.
rules.statement: The synthesis flow shall use sole top m_ahb2axi_top, legal parameter overrides, library, a single i_clk_core constraint, reset treatment and memory mapping.

rules.quote: The five synchronous FIFO storage arrays may map to registers or approved single-clock memory macros; the exact implementation must meet the FIFO contract. Storage năm FIFO đồng bộ có thể ánh xạ thành register hoặc macro bộ nhớ một clock được duyệt; triển khai phải giữ hợp đồng FIFO.
rules.statement: The five synchronous FIFO storage arrays may map to registers or approved single-clock memory macros.

rules.quote: The five synchronous FIFO storage arrays may map to registers or approved single-clock memory macros; the exact implementation must meet the FIFO contract. Storage năm FIFO đồng bộ có thể ánh xạ thành register hoặc macro bộ nhớ một clock được duyệt; triển khai phải giữ hợp đồng FIFO.
rules.statement: The FIFO storage implementation must meet the FIFO contract.

rules.quote: No latches, inferred tri-states, or technology cells outside dedicated wrappers are allowed under REF-003. / Chưa có kết quả tổng hợp. Không latch, tri-state suy diễn hoặc cell công nghệ ngoài wrapper chuyên dụng.
rules.statement: The design must have no latches, inferred tri-states, or technology cells outside dedicated wrappers.

rules.quote: AHB master and AXI Subordinate BFMs shall be independent; expected transactions are computed from accepted AHB pin activity and the stated mappings, not from RTL hierarchy, internal state or generated names. BFM AHB master và AXI Subordinate phải độc lập; expected transaction được tính từ hoạt động pin AHB đã nhận và mapping đã quy định, không dựa vào hierarchy, trạng thái nội bộ hoặc tên RTL.
rules.statement: AHB master and AXI Subordinate BFMs shall be independent of each other.

rules.quote: AHB master and AXI Subordinate BFMs shall be independent; expected transactions are computed from accepted AHB pin activity and the stated mappings, not from RTL hierarchy, internal state or generated names. BFM AHB master và AXI Subordinate phải độc lập; expected transaction được tính từ hoạt động pin AHB đã nhận và mapping đã quy định, không dựa vào hierarchy, trạng thái nội bộ hoặc tên RTL.
rules.condition: When computing expected transactions in verification
rules.statement: Expected transactions shall be computed from accepted AHB pin activity and stated mappings, not from RTL hierarchy, internal state or generated names.

rules.quote: All test sources and run commands shall be retained in the verification deliverable; the verification flow owner shall place all run commands in one Makefile. Test source và lệnh chạy phải lưu trong deliverable verification; flow verification đặt mọi lệnh chạy trong một Makefile.
rules.statement: All test sources and run commands shall be retained in the verification deliverable.

rules.quote: All test sources and run commands shall be retained in the verification deliverable; the verification flow owner shall place all run commands in one Makefile. Test source và lệnh chạy phải lưu trong deliverable verification; flow verification đặt mọi lệnh chạy trong một Makefile.
rules.statement: The verification flow owner shall place all run commands in one Makefile.

rules.quote: Test ID: TEST-07; Stimulus / Kích thích: AXI READY stalls and delayed/missing R/B responses; Expected result / Kết quả mong đợi: VALID/payload stable; no completion bound asserted; no internal timeout; Requirements: REQ-PERF-002/003
rules.condition: During AXI READY stalls and delayed or missing R/B responses (TEST-07)
rules.statement: AXI VALID and payload shall remain stable during READY stalls; no completion bound is asserted and the bridge has no internal timeout.

rules.quote: Test ID: TEST-10; Stimulus / Kích thích: Independent AHB/AXI protocol compliance checks; Expected result / Kết quả mong đợi: No violation on legal traffic; injected endpoint violations are reported; Requirements: REF-001, REF-002
rules.statement: Protocol checks shall report no violation on legal traffic and shall report injected endpoint violations.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: AXI VALID and payload must remain stable while READY=0.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.condition: Before AHB acceptance of the read
rules.statement: No AXI read may be issued before AHB acceptance.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: ARLEN must be 0 for single-beat reads.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: WLAST must be asserted at exactly the final W beat.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.condition: Before complete aggregated AHB burst is captured
rules.statement: No AW may be issued before the complete aggregated AHB burst is captured.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: AHB responses must be returned in order.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: AHB ERROR response must last two cycles.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: Reset must clear AXI VALID.

rules.quote: Required interface properties: AXI VALID/payload stability while READY=0; no AXI read before AHB acceptance; single-beat ARLEN=0; WLAST at exactly the final W beat; no AW before the complete aggregated AHB burst; AHB response ordering; two-cycle ERROR; reset clears VALID; ID values remain below count.
rules.statement: ID values must remain below the configured ID count.

rules.quote: Functional coverage shall cross direction, transfer size, burst type, supported HPROT memory type, bufferable/non-bufferable, byte strobe mask, response status, READY stall length, uniform/varying burst-scoped address attributes, early burst termination, ID count and reset timing. / Property bắt buộc gồm ổn định VALID/payload khi READY=0; không phát read trước AHB accept; ARLEN=0; WLAST đúng beat cuối; không phát AW trước khi gom đủ burst; thứ tự response AHB; ERROR hai chu kỳ; reset xóa VALID; ID nằm trong count. Coverage cross direction, size, burst, bufferable, strobe, status, stall, thuộc tính địa chỉ đồng nhất/thay đổi, count ID và reset.
rules.statement: Functional coverage shall cross direction, size, burst type, HPROT memory type, bufferable/non-bufferable, strobe mask, response status, READY stall length, uniform/varying address attributes, early termination, ID count and reset timing.

rules.quote: Formal checks shall prove ordering, no duplication/loss under legal protocol assumptions, no speculative read, no AXI boundary crossing and response mapping. Reset analysis shall verify the one-reset contract, asynchronous assertion, SoC-synchronized deassertion before the IP boundary, and clearing of FIFO valid state. / Formal kiểm tra thứ tự, không mất/lặp dưới giả định giao thức hợp lệ, không read suy đoán, không vượt biên AXI và mapping response.
rules.statement: Formal checks shall prove ordering, no duplication/loss, no speculative read, no AXI boundary crossing and response mapping.

rules.quote: Static timing analysis shall treat all bridge and FIFO paths as single-clock synchronous paths under i_clk_core; there are no CDC paths or asynchronous clock groups. STA xem mọi đường bridge/FIFO là đường đồng bộ một clock theo i_clk_core; không có đường CDC hay nhóm clock bất đồng bộ.
rules.statement: Static timing analysis shall treat all bridge and FIFO paths as single-clock synchronous paths under i_clk_core, with no CDC paths or asynchronous clock groups.

rules.quote: Reset analysis shall verify the one-reset contract, asynchronous assertion, SoC-synchronized deassertion before the IP boundary, and clearing of FIFO valid state. / Formal kiểm tra thứ tự, không mất/lặp dưới giả định giao thức hợp lệ, không read suy đoán, không vượt biên AXI và mapping response. Reset analysis xác minh hợp đồng một reset, assert bất đồng bộ, nhả đồng bộ tại SoC trước IP và xóa trạng thái valid FIFO.
rules.statement: Reset analysis shall verify the one-reset contract, asynchronous assertion, SoC-synchronized deassertion before the IP boundary, and clearing of FIFO valid state.

rules.quote: Assumption: no IP-specific DFT mode, scan port, MBIST port or test interrupt is included.
rules.statement: The IP includes no IP-specific DFT mode, scan port, MBIST port or test interrupt.

rules.quote: Standard-cell scan insertion and FIFO memory test are owned by the SoC DFT flow; confirm this interface assumption during DFT integration. / Giả định: IP không có DFT mode, scan port, MBIST port hoặc interrupt test riêng.
rules.statement: Standard-cell scan insertion and FIFO memory test are owned by the SoC DFT flow, and this interface assumption is confirmed during DFT integration.

rules.quote: The SoC integrator shall supply the clock frequency/period and uncertainty before STA.
rules.statement: The SoC integrator shall supply the i_clk_core clock frequency/period and uncertainty before static timing analysis.

rules.quote: No clock-domain crossing exceptions are required. Apply only justified reset, generated-clock or memory-macro constraints supplied by the selected library and SoC flow; no numeric exception is invented here. / Không cần exception crossing clock.
rules.statement: No clock-domain crossing exceptions are required; the bridge, AHB, AXI and FIFOs use one synchronous clock domain.

rules.quote: Do not declare asynchronous clock groups or false paths between bridge logic and FIFO pointers. Không khai báo asynchronous clock group hoặc false path giữa logic bridge và pointer FIFO.
rules.condition: timing constraints between bridge logic and FIFO pointers
rules.statement: Asynchronous clock groups or false paths must not be declared between bridge logic and FIFO pointers.

rules.quote: Apply only justified reset, generated-clock or memory-macro constraints supplied by the selected library and SoC flow; no numeric exception is invented here. / Không cần exception crossing clock. Chỉ áp dụng constraint reset, generated clock hoặc macro bộ nhớ khi có căn cứ từ thư viện và flow SoC; không tự đặt exception.
rules.statement: Only justified reset, generated-clock or memory-macro constraints supplied by the selected library and SoC flow shall be applied; no numeric exception is invented.

rules.quote: The synchronous FIFO storage must be mapped to standard cells or a compatible single-clock memory macro. Storage FIFO đồng bộ ánh xạ vào standard cell hoặc macro bộ nhớ một clock tương thích.
rules.statement: The synchronous FIFO storage must be mapped to standard cells or a compatible single-clock memory macro.

rules.quote: Topic: Security attributes; Requirement / Yêu cầu: Preserve HNONSEC and translate supported HPROT fields per §6.3; reject Shareable and unsupported HPROT combinations. No address-based access control.; Status: Defined
rules.statement: The bridge must preserve HNONSEC and translate supported HPROT fields per §6.3.

rules.quote: Topic: Security attributes; Requirement / Yêu cầu: Preserve HNONSEC and translate supported HPROT fields per §6.3; reject Shareable and unsupported HPROT combinations. No address-based access control.; Status: Defined
rules.condition: When a transfer is Shareable or uses an unsupported HPROT combination
rules.statement: The bridge must reject Shareable transfers and unsupported HPROT combinations.

rules.quote: Topic: Security attributes; Requirement / Yêu cầu: Preserve HNONSEC and translate supported HPROT fields per §6.3; reject Shareable and unsupported HPROT combinations. No address-based access control.; Status: Defined
rules.statement: The bridge must not implement address-based access control.

m_ahb2axi_top is the only supported top.
It has one fixed port list.
The bridge has one supported top module, m_ahb2axi_top, which instantiates u_ahb2axi_ctrl.

The design adds three functional RTL modules: m_ahb2axi_ahb_if handles the AHB protocol boundary, m_ahb2axi_ctrl controls transfers between the protocol interfaces, and m_ahb2axi_axi_if is a combinational AXI protocol adapter.
The controller validates and schedules transfers, maps attributes, assembles eligible write bursts, rotates IDs, and coordinates the synchronous queues.
It instantiates one AHB interface module, one AXI interface module, and five reused FIFO instances.
The SoC synchronizes reset deassertion before it reaches the IP.
